Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gujarat High Court to complete the application. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Gujarat High Court for filling up various librarian positions across district judiciaries, industrial courts, and labour courts located in the state of Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 30 vacancies have been announced in this recruitment drive, which includes positions for Librarian under the District Judiciary and Librarian cum Research Assistant under Industrial and Labour Courts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 01 October 2026. Candidates can submit their applications through the designated HC-OJAS recruitment portal starting from this specified date onwards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The final date for submitting the online application form is 20 October 2026. Applicants must complete their submissions well ahead of this deadline to avoid any technical difficulties.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Library and Information Science or its equivalent degree from a recognized university, along with 2 years of relevant working experience in a well-organized library.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants ranges from a minimum of 21 years to a maximum of 37 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories and specific groups as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 750/- for SC, ST, SEBC, EWS, Ex-Servicemen, and PwBD candidates, while all other candidates are required to pay ₹ 1500/- plus usual bank charges.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Main Written Examination consisting of objective-type multiple-choice questions, followed by a Viva-voce test or oral interview for qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary structured in the Pay Matrix of ₹ 25,500 to ₹ 81,100/- per month along with usual allowances as admissible by the government.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official HC-OJAS portal or through the direct application link provided in the important links section of this notification article.
